title: Local-Order Auxiliary Losses Can Improve Autoencoder Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2504.04202v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mean-squared error is the default objective for training autoencoders, yet compressed reconstructions often depend not only on pointwise accuracy but also on preserving local spatial order. We study whether structural auxiliary losses can improve, rather than trade off against, MSE in finite-capacity autoencoders. We introduce finite-difference sign error (FDSE), a local-order auxiliary objective that penalizes disagreements between the signs of neighboring finite differences in the target and reconstruction. FDSE is simple, architecture-agnostic, and differentiable through smooth sign surrogates. Across four tensor reconstruction tasks, we find that moderate mixtures of MSE and FDSE can substantially reduce validation MSE relative to pure MSE training. translated_title: 局部序辅助损失可以改进自编码器重建
translated_abstract: 均方误差（MSE）是训练自编码器的默认目标函数，然而压缩重建的质量往往不仅取决于逐点精度，还取决于是否保留了局部空间顺序。我们研究结构化辅助损失能否在有限容量的自编码器中改进而非与MSE产生权衡。我们提出了有限差分符号误差（FDSE），这是一种局部序辅助目标，它惩罚目标与重建之间相邻有限差分符号的不一致。FDSE简单、与架构无关，并且可以通过平滑的符号替代函数实现可微计算。在四个张量重建任务中，我们发现MSE与FDSE的适度混合可以相对于纯MSE训练显著降低验证MSE。在系数扫描实验中，FDSE混合在这些任务上将验证MSE相比纯MSE降低了2.3倍至7.0倍，同时与其他辅助目标的比较显示FDSE具有（优势）。
tldr: 提出一种局部序辅助损失——有限差分符号误差（FDSE），将其与MSE适度混合训练自编码器，可在多个张量重建任务上将验证MSE相比纯MSE训练降低2.3至7.0倍。
en_tdlr: Proposing finite-difference sign error (FDSE), a local-order auxiliary loss that, when moderately mixed with MSE, reduces validation MSE by 2.3×–7.0× over pure MSE training for autoencoders across tensor reconstruction tasks.
